question_text: Outline why a client-server application may keep the database and its access credentials on the server rather than sending them to every client.
adaptation_rationale: Retains central-resource/security reasoning as client-server model application; no PHP/JavaScript-language requirement.
solution: The server controls access to the central data resource.; Keeping credentials there avoids distributing them to client devices that users can inspect.
